description: This file defines the Delete feature for articles in the Conduit application, including command validation and handling logic to delete an article by its slug.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates that the Slug in the command is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the deletion of an article identified by its slug.

methods.name: Delete.CommandValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets up validation rules for the command.

methods.name: Delete.QueryHandler.Handle
methods.description: Executes the deletion process for the specified article.
